MIND. [1] [Croc.]
Child sits or stands up in bed making various quick movements without being conscious of what he is doing ; this is followed by a short interval of quietness, in which he may regain consciousness, but without any knowledge of what has passed ; this remission followed by another attack, and so on ; febrile condition with congestion to head ; eyes fixed and bright ; redness and heat of face ; urine pale and scant ; desires neither food nor drink.
On attempting to write something down, cannot, on account of loss of recollection.
Greatly concerned about his life, believes that he will die, is no longer fit for business. θ Epistaxis.
Extravagant ideas and great loquacity.
Sings involuntarily, on hearing even a single note sung ; laughs at herself, but soon sings again in spite of her determination to stop.
Jumping, dancing, laughing, whistling ; very affectionate, wants to kiss everybody.
Gayety ; uncommon mirth and cheerfulness ; witty.
Changeable disposition, depression and hilarity.
Alternations of excessive happy affectionate tenderness and rage.
Restless, anxious, sorrowful mood ; deep melancholy.
Excessive timidity.
Vexation, contradicted by bursts of laughter.
He takes everything in anger and suddenly repents of having injured others.
Great ill humor ; behavior of relatives and friends excites her to anger, and she is at the point of permitting an outbreak of passion towards them, but at this moment she feels calm ; at next moment this calmness seems a weakness ; she is vexed with herself, and her anger becomes greater than ever ; this very unusual vacillation of mood lasts several hours.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Croc.]
Giddiness with fainting.
Vertigo : as if intoxicated, in forehead ; in room, but not in open air ; with confusion ; and heat of whole body ; staggering and giddiness when raising head after lying down at night.
Congestion of head, with nosebleed.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Croc.]
Sudden shock in forehead and temples.
Pain in forehead in evening by candlelight, with burning and pressure in eyes.
Sudden broad thrust in right temple, extending deep into brain, causing him to start ; above left frontal eminence, extending deep into brain.
Pulsating pains in left side of head extending into eye.
Sudden cold sensation on left parietal bone, as if a drop of cold water had fallen on it.
When moving head, sensation as if brain was loose.
Congestion of head ; violent throbbing.
Nervous or menstrual headache.
Headache during climacteric period with throbbing, pulsating pains in various parts of head, pressure in eyes, dilatation of vessels of head and of other parts of body ; < during period in which she was accustomed to have menstrual flow, pain continuing at that time two or three days without remission, preventing sleep.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Croc.]
Vertigo when raising head, with heat of body.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Croc.]
Eyes fixed and shining. θ Cerebral disturbance.
Sudden flashes before eyes like electric sparks.
Appearance of a spot jumping up and down before sight.
On reading, the paper looks pale red or rose color, shines.
The light seems dim, as if obscured by a veil.
Acute tearing pain in head and right eye, with dimness of vision, and a sensation as if cold air was rushing through eye.
Sore burning in eyes after reading awhile ; also dimness, must wink frequently.
Pupils much dilated.
Pain in eye to top of head, pain in left eye darting to right ; sensation of cold wind blowing across eyes. θ Sclero-choroiditis post. θ Asthenopia.
A few moments' use of eyes causes feeling in them as if room was filled with smoke ; feeling of dryness and burning, very soon succeeded by lachrymation ; pressure on closed lids relieves somewhat.
Feeling in eyes as if she had been violently weeping, with corresponding appearance of weeping ; beginning in left and extending to right eye ; feeling of something alive and moving in abdomen (r. side). θ Conjunctivitis.
Feeling as though water was constantly coming into eyes, only in room.
Sensation as if she had been looking through too sharp spectacles.
Feeling as of biting smoke in eyes.
Worse from looking fixedly at an object, cannot even thread a needle.
Ophthalmia menstrual in patients of a sanguine temperament, subject to attacks of congestion and inclination to spasms (hysterical) at climacteric period.
Extreme photophobia and most copious lachrymation ; impossible to read without a torrent of tears inundating eyes, so that light gets confused and veiled.
Lachrymation in room ; not in open air.
Constant winking, with tearful suffusion of eyes.
Must wink and wipe eyes frequently, as though a film of mucus was over them.
Twitching of eyelids.
Jerking, twitching and itching in upper lid.
Nightly spasms of lids.
Sensation as if eyelids were swollen.
Inclined to press lids tightly together from time to time.
Heating and lancinating pains in eyes after surgical operations.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Croc.]
Humming and roaring in ears, causing impairment of hearing, < when stooping.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Croc.]
Mild pressure in forehead precedes attack of nosebleed ; he is very anxious, believing that he will die, constant coldness of hands and feet ; towards evening, congestion of blood to head, with warmth of face, quivering in left eyelid, sour taste in mouth, pulse full and quick.
Epistaxis of very tenacious, thick, black blood, every drop drawn into a thread, with cold sweat in large drops on forehead.
Violent sneezing ; coryza with stringy mucus.
Bloody mucus, or dark, stringy blood from nose.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Croc.]
Yellowish, sallow color of face. θ Epistaxis. θ Metrorrhagia.
Livid complexion, or circumscribed, burning red spots.
Red, hot face, or alternate redness and paleness.
Redness and heat of face, with congestion to head. θ Cerebral disturbance.
Sensation of warmth in face, with congestion to head and twitching in left eyelid. θ Epistaxis.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Croc.]
Lips cracked.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Croc.]
Tongue moist, dirty and coated in centre. θ Metrorrhagia.
Tongue coated white, papillæ elevated, > after breakfast.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Croc.]
Unusual warmth in mouth.
Sour taste in mouth. θ Epistaxis.
Foul odor from mouth. θ Metrorrhagia.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Croc.]
Feeling as if uvula was elongated, during and when not swallowing.
Elongation of uvula.
Sensation in œsophagus as from a plug.
Scraping in throat in evening before and after, but not during time he takes his food.
Scraping rough throat.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Croc.]
Excessive thirst for cold drinks ; thirst in evening.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Croc.]
Eructations, tasteless.
Violent heartburn.
Feeling of nausea in chest and throat.
Nausea, disappearing in open air.
